_note: Single place for watcher thresholds (ORISO-Docs#207). stalledDays: an open item whose last update is MORE than this many days old in that status is flagged; statuses not listed are never flagged as stalled.
_jobStaleNote: job-stale (ORISO-Docs#216): an agent job whose section says running and was last updated MORE than this many hours before the sync is flagged. Open question of the spec: 24 h is the proposal.

gate._note: Reviewed Gate -> Status mapping (ORISO-Docs#211). The Gate/Status mismatch watcher flags an item whose Status is not in the list of its Gate; items without a Gate are never flagged. Reviewed deviations from the spec's strict pairing: P4 also allows In progress (an agent that starts moves the card to In progress while the gate stays P4 until R1); R4 also allows QA external and Done (the gate stays at the last one reached once the client's lifecycle takes over); every gate allows On hold (a pause is orthogonal).
